decisions.reason: As a flagship electrification line in a growing firm and industry, this product would likely be retained because management can use organisational slack to keep learning unless performance falls clearly below aspiration.

This heater is less central than the firm's flagship directions, so it remains the most plausible pruning candidate, but its fit with the existing offer and the firm's current growth make continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.

Because this industrial hall heater line is close to the firm's core applications and complements its broad system business, management would likely keep it while monitoring whether results stay at least near aspiration.

The hydrogen-capable line is strategically important for the firm's lower-carbon path and already has operational reference use, so any shortfall would more likely trigger refinement than discontinuation.
